scope: One original native lifetime: event-bound NEW_GAME observation, retained worker exit0, later ADV and desktop recovery. Not formal complete game acceptance.
method: Offline original JSON/raw-byte re-decoding without importing collectors or production verification functions; compared all captured EBP links and NEW_GAME ancestry memory against the actual recorded stack.
limitations: Single native lifetime, sampled contexts and retained exit queries do not establish full independent replay or final acceptance.
PTD clear/free, full constructor execution, complete resource cleanup and continuous ownership are not independently traced.
Oplock changes I/O timing; the observed break timestamp is notification observation, not exact kernel break initiation.
The protected child cleanup status 0xc0000354 is recorded; parent exit0 and worker exit0 do not establish successful WinMain return.
Original desktop checks remain failed; later unmodified recovery records establish restoration within the authorized window.

lifecycle.close_request.elapsed is evaluated before wrapped post() executes the probe, so it is not actual WM_CLOSE dispatch time; the authenticated wrapper dispatches original.post only after probe return.
